title: Tuesday 260901
wodRaw:
Front squat 3-3-3-2-2-1-1 reps

Compare to similar on [260707](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2026/07/07) and [260408](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2026/04/08).

Post loads to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's the day to lift heavy relative to your capacity. It's a session that demands full focus and attention on every set.
Check back on your most recent heavy front squat days from April 8 and July 7 to help navigate today's weight, or if you know a recent 1-rep-max front squat, aim for 75% or more of that number. If you did yesterday's workout, expect today's legs to reflect it — don't be discouraged if the weight feels lighter than usual. Start a new set every 3 minutes so you get plenty of rest between lifts; if you don't need that much recovery, go heavier, as long as your mechanics hold up. Newer athletes should lighten the load and prioritize quality reps over chasing heavier numbers.

**Intermediate option:**  
Same as Rx'd

**Beginner option:**   
Front squat **5-5-5-5-5-5-5** reps

**Resources:**  
[The Front Squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-front-squat)

title: Wednesday 260902
wodRaw:
On a 10-minute clock, complete:  
50 burpee pull-ups  
75 kettlebell swings  
Max burpee pull-ups in the remaining time

The pull-up bar should be 6 inches above the fingertips with arms extended overhead. Your score is the number of burpee pull-ups completed.

♀ 35-lb kettlebell  
♂ 53-lb kettlebell

Post your reps to the comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's workout is a grind with a “rewarding” push at the end! Move through the first set of burpee pull-ups and kettlebell swings as quickly as possible, then, in the remaining time, perform as many burpee pull-ups as possible. Aim to complete the first set of burpee pull-ups in under 6 minutes. Choose a light kettlebell load that allows you to finish the swings in under 3:30 and in 2-3 sets. You should have at least 30 seconds to complete burpee pull-ups at the end of the workout. Some advanced athletes may have 3 minutes or more. 

**Intermediate option:**  
On a 10-minute clock, complete:
**35** burpee pull-ups  
**50** kettlebell swings  
Max burpee pull-ups in the remaining time

**Fingertips should touch the pull-up bar with arms extended overhead.** Your score is the number of burpee pull-ups completed.

♀ 35-lb kettlebell  
♂ 53-lb kettlebell

**Beginner option:**   
On a 10-minute clock, complete:  
**25 burpees**  
**25 jumping** pull-ups  
**50** kettlebell swings  
Max burpee **jumping** pull-ups in the remaining time

**Mid-forearm should touch the pull-up bar with arms extended overhead.** Your score is the number of **jumping** burpee pull-ups completed.

♀ **15**-lb kettlebell  
♂ **25**-lb kettlebell

**Resources:**  
[The Burpee Pull-Up](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WVyFdjd96rM&feature=youtu.be)  
[The Kettlebell Swing](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kettlebell-swing)  
[Burpee Pull-Up Tips](https://youtu.be/iQWQ4JgtqXo)  
[The Burpee](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-burpee)  
[Jumping Pull-Up Progression](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KdjfFHefFkg)

title: Friday 260904
wodRaw:
21-15-9* reps for time of:  
Clean and jerks  
Echo bike calories

*Women complete 15-12-9 Echo bike calories.

Then, at 20 minutes:   
Build to a challenging power clean and jerk

♀ 65-lb barbell  
♂ 95-lb barbell

Post time and load to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's time domain tells you everything you need to know about this workout — it's fast! The light clean and jerks are meant to be completed in 1-3 sets across all rounds, with only brief rest breaks. Choose a load that lets you do at least 15 reps with smooth, high-quality movement. The bike is low skill, low repetition, but will challenge your respiratory system — find a calorie count that lets you hold a consistent moderate-to-hard effort. It should feel uncomfortable, but manageable. The set of 21 shouldn't take longer than 90 seconds. Today is about moving fast and consistently, with enough clarity and control to move the barbell well.

After the workout, feel free to take 10 minutes — or until your clock hits 20 minutes — to build to a challenging but not maximal power clean and jerk.

**Intermediate option:**  
**15-12-9** reps for time of:  
Clean and jerks  
Echo bike calories

Women complete **12-9-6** Echo bike calories.

Then, at 20 minutes:   
Build to a challenging power clean and jerk

♀ 65-lb barbell  
♂ 95-lb barbell

**Beginner option:**   
**15-10-5** reps for time of:  
Clean and jerks  
Echo bike calories

Women complete **12-8-4** Echo bike calories.

Then, at 20 minutes:   
Build to a challenging power clean and jerk

♀ **35**-lb barbell  
♂ **45**-lb barbell

**Resources:**  
[The Power Clean and Push Jerk](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-clean-jerk)   
[Rogue Echo Bike](https://www.roguefitness.com/rogue-echo-bike)

title: Saturday 260905
wodRaw:
5 rounds for time of:  
200-meter run  
20 air squats  
20 push-ups  
20 lunges

Post time to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's workout is simple but challenging, regardless of your ability level. Some of you may have done it at the 2026 CrossFit Owners and Coaches Conference in the park. 

If you're proficient with the movement, challenge yourself to move at a very fast pace from the start and hang on. Expect the squat-and-lunge combination to fatigue your legs more than you might anticipate — these movements will make the runs harder too, so try to hold a steady, consistent pace. The push-ups may end up being the toughest part when performed with great mechanics and full range of motion. Be strategic about how you manage your reps: break them up before muscular failure sets in, and use short rest breaks.

**Intermediate option:**    
5 rounds for time of:  
200-meter run  
20 air squats  
**10** push-ups  
20 lunges

**Beginner option:**   
5 rounds for time of:  
200-meter run  
**10** air squats  
**10** push-ups **from the knees**  
**10** lunges

**Resources:**  
[Running | Falling Forward](https://youtu.be/zSrMZRh3ymk)  
[The Air Squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-air-squat)  
[The Push-Up](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-up)  
[The Lunge](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-walking-lunge)

title: Monday 260907
wodRaw:
Push press 5-5-5-5-5 reps

Compare to [250709](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2025/07/09).

Post loads to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's heavy day focuses on building strength overhead. Build to a challenging set of 5 push presses, then stay at that weight for all 5 working sets.

Your working weight shouldn't lead to failure, but it should require at least 2 minutes of rest — aim for 70% or more of your 1-rep max across all 5 sets, resting 2-3 minutes between them. You can choose whether to touch-and-go or stop and reset between each rep, depending on your comfort level today.

**Intermediate option:**  
Same as Rx'd.

**Beginner option:**   
Same as Rx'd.

**Resources:**  
[The Push Press](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-press)

title: Wednesday 260909
wodRaw:
15-12-9 reps for load and time of:  
Hang power cleans  
Bar-facing burpees

Use the same weight for all three sets.  
All hang power clean sets must be unbroken; if you drop the bar, start the set over.

Post load and time to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's conditioning element is a mix of heavy and fast movements. Shoot to complete this workout in under 8 minutes; advanced athletes may finish in closer to 5.

Find a challenging hang power clean weight you can maintain for unbroken sets — a general guideline is 60-70% of your 1-rep max. If you drop the bar on any set, you must start over, so the load should be heavy enough that you'll want a little rest before each round of cleans to keep them unbroken.

Try to maintain a steady, consistent pace on the burpees. The rounds of 15 and 12 can even be treated like a "hard rest" before the next set of cleans, while the final 9 reps should be a sprint to the finish.

**Intermediate option:**  
Same as Rx'd.

**Beginner option:**  
15-12-9 reps for load and time of:  
Hang power cleans  
Bar-facing **up-down + step-overs**

Use the same weight for all three sets.  
All hang power clean sets must be unbroken; if you drop the bar, start the set over.

**Resources:**  
[The Hang Power Clean](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-hang-power-clean)  
[The Bar-Facing Burpee](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jHfOhxEKtOc&feature=youtu.be)

title: Friday 260911
wodRaw:
**Andi**

For time:  
100 hang power snatches  
100 push presses  
100 sumo deadlift high pulls  
100 front squats

♀ 45-lb barbell  
♂ 65-lb barbell

Compare to [260429](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2026/04/29).

Post your time to the comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's workout is the CrossFit benchmark Andi. We last completed this workout in April, so you have an opportunity see if you can improve your time.

Go for large sets from start to finish — ideally opening with at least 20 reps, then several sets of 15, never dropping below 10. If you're unable to hit that stimulus, reduce load or volume as needed.

In the warm-up, expect to demonstrate 15 sound, unbroken reps of each movement to earn that load for the workout. Don't mistake the light loads as an invitation to go as prescribed when that's not normally your approach — choose an easy load and move faster instead.

With a light load and high volume, it's easier to shorten your range of motion or move poorly as you fatigue. Maintain full range of motion through all movements, and don't be surprised if you need to slow down at some point to clean up your technique.

**Intermediate option:**  
For time:  
**70** hang power snatches  
**70** push presses  
**70** sumo deadlift high pulls  
**70** front squats

♀ **35**-lb barbell  
♂ **45**-lb barbell

**Beginner option:**

**50** push presses

**50** front squats

♀ **15**-lb barbell

title: Saturday 260912
wodRaw:
Complete as many reps as possible in 12 minutes of:  
2 wall walks  
2 legless rope climbs

Add 1 wall walk every round. 

Post reps to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today, we have a gymnastics couplet with legless rope climbs and ascending wall walks.

Shoot to complete sets of 2 wall walks in 45 seconds or faster; scale the range of motion up the wall as needed, but the goal is to get inverted today. Rope climbs should be done in under 1 minute — scale by using your legs, reducing the range of motion, or substituting pull-to-stands. If you can, give the legless rope climbs a try, even if you can't get all the way to the top. 
 
**Intermediate option:**  
Complete as many reps as possible in 12 minutes of:  
2 wall walks  
2 **rope climbs**

Add 1 wall walk every round. 

**Beginner option:**   
Complete as many reps as possible in 12 minutes of:  
2 **inchworm + push-ups**  
2 **pull-to-stands**

Add **1 inchworm + push-up** every round.

**Resources:**  
[The Wall Walk](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-wall-walk)  
[The Legless Rope Climb](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-legless-rope-climb)  
[The Rope Climb (Basket)](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-rope-climb-basket)
